# Nemours KidsHealth

> Trusted physician-reviewed children's health information covering development, medical conditions, nutrition, safety, and family wellness from pregnancy through teen years.

Nemours KidsHealth is the web's most visited site about children's health, offering comprehensive, evidence-based guidance for parents and kids. The site provides resources in both English and Spanish, with content organized by life stage and health topic, including condition-specific wellness centers.

## Key Topics

- Child development and milestones
- Parenting guidance and family life
- Common infections and illnesses
- Chronic conditions (asthma, allergies, ADHD, diabetes)
- Pregnancy and newborn care
- Mental health and behavior
- Nutrition and fitness
- First aid and safety
- Vaccines and preventive care
- Body systems and anatomy
- School readiness and learning
- Healthcare navigation
- Emergency preparedness
- Developmental milestones
- Bilingual resources

## Parent Health Guides

- [Parents](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents): Main parents hub with health advice from pregnancy through teen years
- [General Health](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/general): Guide to common conditions, illnesses, body basics, and sick child care
- [Growth & Development](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/growth): Child development guide covering milestones from infancy through teen years
- [Pregnancy & Baby](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/pregnancy-newborn): Pregnancy and newborn care guide: prenatal health, labor, babyproofing
- [Emotions & Behavior](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/emotions): Behavioral and mental health guide: ADHD, depression, eating disorders
- [School & Family Life](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/positive): School and family guidance: learning, reading, screen time, tough talks

## Medical Reference & Conditions

- [Diseases & Conditions](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/medical): Medical reference for chronic conditions: asthma, allergies, diabetes, cancer
- [Infections](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/infections): Reference on common and uncommon infections, symptoms, and treatments
- [Wellness Centers](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/centers/center.html): Wellness centers directory for asthma, allergies, cancer, and other conditions
- [Health Topics Directory](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/all-categories.html): Directory of doctor-reviewed health topics and condition centers

## Wellness & Safety

- [Nutrition & Fitness](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/nutrition-center): Nutrition and fitness guide for healthy eating and active kids
- [First Aid & Safety](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/firstaid-safe): Safety and first aid guide: emergency care, CPR, injury prevention

## Healthcare Navigation & Support

- [Doctors & Hospitals](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/system): Healthcare navigation: doctor visits, tests, surgery, insurance, medicines
- [KidsHealth Videos](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/videos): Video library on health conditions, procedures, baby care, and body basics
- [Q&A](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/question): Q&A section with expert answers on parenting, health, and child development
- [Milestones Newsletter](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/milestones-newsletter.html): Newsletter signup for age-customized baby development and parenting content

## Spanish Language Resources

- [Para Padres (Parents in Spanish)](https://kidshealth.org/es/parents): Spanish-language parents section covering child health, development, and safety
- [Para Niños (Kids in Spanish)](https://kidshealth.org/es/kids): Spanish-language kids section on body systems, wellness, and hygiene

## Optional

- [Nemours KidsHealth Celebrates 30 Years](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/celebrating-30-years.html): Anniversary page celebrating 30 years as pioneering children's health resource
